scene_grammar.kicker: MATHENE · <record_id> · <CLAIM_STATUS> — the claim-status band travels with the formal content on every scene
scene_grammar.text_layers: kicker carries record id + status; title is the record's own title; italic carries the one-line operation; body carries the record's governing derivation compressed FROM THE RECORD — locked first-use sequences in full, backticked-token typography, defined/undefined seam kept visible
scene_grammar.shapes: text glyphs for tokens and relations; ring for the #0/#5 envelope and completed circuits; square for the fundamental polygon and held fields; disc for poles; triangle for the catuskoti/diadic cornering; yantra for structured wholes; cymatic where the record is itself about resonance
scene_grammar.sequences: entity step sequences are used only where the record's own operation is a directed passage: the crossed-zero recognition sequence, both Spanda equations, the 64/36→16/9→9/8→2/1 reduction chain, the phase-flip F→R(F) pulse, dia's operator changes, Laws-of-Form oscillation, Gödel's fixed-point ladder, group completion
scene_grammar.mandala: concentric mandala per ql-expression-grammar.md §III is the canonical QL-unit plate: centre = the 0/1 threshold and governing proposition (never a summary badge); four cardinal stations #1–#4 at N/E/W/S per the theorem degree table (N 0° · E 90° · W 270° · S 180°); enclosing ring = the #0/#5 envelope, frame never content; −/− opens above the centre, 1/0 returns at the rim — the (4+2)+2 brackets staged on the envelope; the mandala is the torus's flat projection (derived warrant, usable as scene geometry)

rules: notation is locked: backticked tokens appear exactly as the records write them (−/+ with U+2212, ∞/dx, Ø, 9/8, 4+2, 5→0); Unicode inside tokens, never LaTeX
the two logics appear in their locked full expressions on first use per surface: dia-ballein `(-1)/(+1)`, sym-ballein `(0/1)/(1/0)`
never invent math: every derivation a scene shows is the record's own; the defined/undefined seam of ordinary arithmetic stays visible wherever a record states it
mathematical correctness beats visual flourish; a scene fails if it decorates instead of showing the operation
content-required glyphs/diagrams are authored here and retained with provenance 'authored' in the binding record
quiet records stay quiet: a one-relation record gets one governing formation
